title: Dev-Realisation Exhaustion Sweep (Semantic Contract Classification)
authorityBoundary: Lower authority than semantic contracts, ADRs, validators, and the current-main capability-service realisation map. Classification records dev-realisation intent only and MUST NOT upgrade readiness.

rows.reason: Local login route contract implemented and mapped to semantic authority with bounded dev/test evidence; realised and proven in dev only (no product/public/live claim).
A background worker/job runner needs a runtime worker substrate plus execution/failure negative-path proofs; realisation is a test-proof-ladder rung.
Runtime secrets management (write-only, redaction, no-read-back) is provable at the test rung with a local store; a live secret provider is a later rung.
Marked not-applicable-final and excluded from V2 scope (only a healthz route recorded); a later semantic decision is required before dev realisation.
